messages:
Aisha: quick design check  dashboard table mock attached https://redwood.app/s/ux-density — question: keep current compact rows (8px) or move to 12px for better touch and keyboard hit targets? also toasts overlap the action menu in this layout.
Jon: prefer 12px. focus rings and hit areas feel cramped otherwise, especially on tablet. we can tighten icon gutters to save vertical space.
Priya: +1. also token cleanup needed  i keep finding raw numbers instead of named tokens like `space.compact`. can we standardize before shipping spacing changes?
Sam: small copy tweak  change `Export` action to `Download CSV` for clarity.
design-lint-bot: a11y: `.btn-secondary` contrast 3.7:1 on white. WCAG AA needs 4.5:1. Recommend darken to #BDBDBD or add 1px #CCC border.
Aisha: thanks. plan: Jon add two storybook stories (`Table/RowDensity/compact` and `/touch-friendly`) with screenshots at 1024px and 375px; Priya open token rename PR with migration table; Sam will patch copy and toast stacking (z-index:1200, pointer-events). we'll run axe scan on both. decision: default to touch-friendly if dashboard item loss is minimal.
